subtopic: Who may act under the order
stem: A Commissioner order authorising administration of a designated vaccine is in force in Massachusetts. A pharmacy wishes to use a student enrolled in an approved programme for licensure as a health care professional to help administer doses. What does the regulation require for the student?

choices.text: The student may act on the same footing as a licensed professional.
The student must be authorised and supervised by a licensed qualified professional.
The student may not administer vaccine under this pathway in any circumstances.
The student must hold a separate Department certification before assisting.
The student may act only where the pharmacy notifies the Commissioner first.

explanation.core_reasoning: The pathway at 105 CMR 700.003(F) reaches a student duly enrolled in an approved or accredited programme for licensure as a health care professional and acting in accordance with that programme's policies, and 700.003(F)(1)(c) requires that a student administering vaccine be AUTHORISED AND SUPERVISED BY A LICENSED AND QUALIFIED HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONAL.

choice_analysis.A: The student limb carries its own supervision condition.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: authorisation and supervision are both required.
choice_analysis.C: Students are expressly within the pathway.
choice_analysis.E: No notification requirement attaches to the student limb.

related_facts: The Commissioner's order and a practitioner instrument are still required
explanation.mpje_trap: Candidates assume a general authorisation covers everyone the pathway names.

reasoning_steps: Confirm the student is enrolled in an approved or accredited programme
Apply the authorisation and supervision condition
Note the programme's own policies also govern
